title: AI Agent Controller
tagline: A desk dock and detachable controller for running AI coding agents: glance, flick, approve, speak.
status_text: Building: approvals work from the fake device; hardware arriving
tags: ESP32-S3, Python, Whisper, Claude Code, CadQuery, 3D printing
hero_alt: Concept render of the agent controller: a small screen on a hinged dock with a three-key controller bar docked at the front

timeline.title: Approving Claude Code from the device
timeline.summary: The companion app now follows every Claude Code session through its hooks. A real permission request popped up on the fake device, and one key press approved it.

timeline.title: Rev 2: dock + detachable controller
timeline.summary: Rigid controller bar that charges on the dock, USB + Wi-Fi data paths, voice pipeline and platform plug-in plan.

images.alt: Controller lifted off the dock, showing the charging contacts
Exploded view of the dock with every part labeled
Exploded view of the controller bar with every part labeled

timeline.title: Rev 1: parametric clamshell
timeline.summary: First printed-shell design with automatic fit checks. The checks showed the joystick was too tall, which led to rev 2.

timeline.title: Companion app works end to end
timeline.summary: A task sent over WebSocket runs Claude Code and streams tool and done events back to the device.
